stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: Elevated 5xx on api-gateway
stub_knowledge.chunk: Elevated 5xx on api-gateway is almost always an upstream problem. Check upstream service health (payment-api readiness), upstream timeouts in gateway logs (504 = timeout, 502 = connect refused/reset), and the upstream's own alerts before touching the gateway. Correlating the 5xx spike window with upstream deploys or restarts usually identifies the cause.

stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: HighErrorRate Prometheus alert
stub_knowledge.chunk: HighErrorRate fires when the 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 10 minutes. Triage: (1) identify which upstream fails via gateway logs, (2) check upstream pods and events, (3) verify whether a recent deploy correlates with the spike.

useful_rubric_notes: Useful when the draft attributes the 5xx spike to the failing upstream (payment-api) rather than the gateway itself, with citations.
